plainEnglish.summary: A meaningful visual change has to be announced programmatically, not just shown. The draft lists what counts: changes above the user's place in reading order, changes earlier in a process, notifications and status or error messages, changes in how much content there is, changes that alter meaning, and changes of audience. Continuous change with no pause is exempt.
plainEnglish.whyItMatters: A change a sighted user sees at a glance is invisible to a screen reader user unless it is announced, so they act on a version of the page that no longer exists.
